_note: x402 endpoint catalog. Discovery is substring/keyword match over `name`, `description`, `tags`. `method` is GET or POST (case-insensitive). For POST/PUT/PATCH, `body_template` is sent as an application/json body. `{subject}` / `{token}` in `url` or in any string value of `body_template` is replaced with the token the user asked about. `cost_usd` is the expected price shown at confirmation; the REAL price is read from the endpoint's own 402 before anything is pulled, and is capped at `cost_usd * 1.5`. RUN `bun run scripts/x402-verify.ts` BEFORE ANY REAL-MONEY DEMO — it probes every entry's live 402 for free and is how the dead `token-risk` endpoint (502 from its own nginx) and the 50x-overstated Heurist prices were found. Sourced from the CDP x402 Bazaar (via x402scan) — see X402.md.
